tool_and_environment_findings.what: the dispatcher was given --json-out and --output-root values in MSYS form (/c/Projects/...). A native process resolves a leading / against the CURRENT DRIVE ROOT, so receipts and per-attempt stdout/stderr were written to C:\c\Projects\... instead of the round directory. Detected by the absence of the expected files, then located and moved back into the round directory; the stray C:\c\Projects tree was removed.
tool_and_environment_findings.disclosure: a second stray tree C:\c\Users\... (a file named SOUL.md) belongs to a different writer and was left untouched
tool_and_environment_findings.rule: hand every native tool a C:/ forward-slash path, never /c/...

tool_and_environment_findings.what: config/hermes-codex-lane.json pins codex_executable at C:/Users/user/AppData/Local/OpenAI/Codex/bin/2e5e00daee91c61d/codex.exe, which does not exist; the only live binary is 9614f1d9b40d9c4f/codex.exe (sha256 e98c516f...). The launcher refuses every action until that precondition passes, which is why the relay was down and every lane turn came back empty.
tool_and_environment_findings.disposition: recorded, NOT repaired in this round: retargeting the canonical pin is a control-plane change and belongs to the tool-drift item under its own change. The lanes were driven through the documented --codex-executable seam instead, and that is stated wherever the receipts are cited.
